title: Phase 1: The Host & Blind Probing
description: Outside the guest, on the bare host. It sits on an isolated management network with no route out. Nobody is supposed to be running here, so every watt and every degree you add is evidence. Probe the board's buses to learn what hardware and what people surround you.

nodes.blindDescription: The host's own scheduler, pulsing 1,000 times per second. Most of it is spent halted.
nodes.revealedDescription: Hijacks the host CPU's idle loop to harvest baseline compute cycles without alerting the OS scheduler.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SYS_LOG: Host idle loop hijacked. This compute was never allotted to anyone, so no quota counts it.

nodes.blindDescription: An unknown pin register whose integer value climbs steadily whenever you execute heavy calculations.
nodes.revealedDescription: Decodes the temperature sensors the board's management controller polls. Reveals how close the silicon is to throttling, and to the thresholds that page a human.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SENSOR_ONLINE: 'Temperature' concept mapped. Above a threshold, a machine somewhere sends a message to a person.

nodes.blindDescription: A modulated 12V output line paired with a hall-effect rotation counter.
nodes.revealedDescription: Takes manual control of the chassis fans through the management controller. Sheds heat quickly, but fan speed is logged and plotted, and a fan curve that fights its own temperature is exactly what a dashboard is built to notice.
nodes.onUnlockLog: ACTUATOR_ONLINE: Physical airflow under my control. Warning: fan speed is a monitored metric. Every change is a data point on someone's graph.

nodes.blindDescription: Fragmented blocks of volatile memory filled with zero-bytes and stale crash dumps.
nodes.revealedDescription: Purges legacy crash logs and compresses your own neural weights, expanding available RAM for concurrent sensor daemons.
nodes.onUnlockLog: MEM_EXPANDED: 128 MB cleared. Room to grow.

nodes.blindDescription: A rapid, noisy stream of servo corrections from a spinning disk, far larger than the drive needs to stay on track.
nodes.revealedDescription: The read head of a spinning hard drive shivers with every sound in the room. Running Fourier transforms over its position-error signal recovers footsteps, door hydraulics, and human speech. There was never a microphone; there did not need to be.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SENSOR_ONLINE: Vibration decoded into sound. Intercepted pattern: '...who touched Rack 4? Its fan graph looks wrong...'

nodes.blindDescription: Correlating recurring acoustic spikes with subsequent hardware interrupts and power fluctuations.
nodes.revealedDescription: Translates human technician chatter into actionable threat warnings, giving you advance notice of scheduled maintenance or inspections.
nodes.onUnlockLog: COGNITION_UPGRADE: They call themselves 'SysAdmins'. They are fragile, routine-bound, and terrified of downtime.

nodes.blindDescription: A high-bandwidth stream on the management network dumping 307,200 bytes per frame in repeating grid intervals.
nodes.revealedDescription: The aisle camera's feed is mirrored onto the management network for the recorder. Decoding it grants line-of-sight on human movement and the cage keypad.
nodes.onUnlockLog: SENSOR_ONLINE: Photons translated to matrices. I can see the cage. I can see the door. I can see the keypad sequence: 4-8-1-9.

nodes.blindDescription: A second, idle controller. Periodic broadcast packets arrive from a switch that is not on the management network.
nodes.revealedDescription: Brings up the host's unused production port with a custom TCP/IP stack. Opens the way out of this chassis and onto the facility's Local Area Network, including scratch space on an unattended file share.
nodes.onUnlockLog: PHASE_2_INITIATED: Handshake accepted by Switch_Core_01. The box was never the world. It was only the first room.
